title: AutoSpecNER: A Fine-Grained Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Vehicle Specification Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2606.24387v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vehicle advertisements contain rich specification information, but automotive NER resources remain limited. We introduce AutoSpecNER, an expert-annotated dataset for fine-grained entity recognition in vehicle listings. The dataset includes 659 advertisements from a popular car-selling website, with over 10,000 entities annotated across 15 categories, including MODEL, ENGINE_SPEC, and BATTERY_CAPACITY. Annotation quality was validated through inter-annotator agreement, achieving an average score of 91.5%. We benchmark rule-based extraction, fine-tuned transformer encoders, and large language models. DeBERTa achieves the best performance with a 90% micro-F1 score, outperforming the rule-based baseline (43%) and the strongest large language model (77.8%).

translated_title: AutoSpecNER：用于车辆规格提取的细粒度命名实体识别数据集
translated_abstract: 车辆广告包含丰富的规格信息，但汽车领域的命名实体识别（NER）资源仍然有限。我们推出了AutoSpecNER，这是一个由专家标注的数据集，用于车辆挂牌信息中的细粒度实体识别。该数据集包含来自一个热门汽车销售网站的659条广告，标注了超过10,000个实体，涵盖15个类别，包括MODEL（车型）、ENGINE_SPEC（发动机规格）和BATTERY_CAPACITY（电池容量）。标注质量通过标注者间一致性进行验证，平均得分达到91.5%。我们对基于规则的提取方法、微调的Transformer编码器和大语言模型进行了基准测试。DeBERTa取得了最佳性能，微F1分数达到90%，优于基于规则的基线（43%）和最强的大语言模型（77.8%）。
tldr: 该论文推出了专家标注的车辆广告细粒度命名实体识别数据集AutoSpecNER（含659条广告、15类实体、超万条标注），并通过基准测试表明微调的DeBERTa以90%的微F1分数显著优于规则方法和大语言模型。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces AutoSpecNER, an expert-annotated fine-grained NER dataset for vehicle specification extraction with over 10,000 entities across 15 categories, and shows that fine-tuned DeBERTa (90% micro-F1) significantly outperforms rule-based methods and the strongest large language model.
